focus: Truck-rental desks with Miami addresses (six Penske locations, including two Home Depot stores, five company-run U-Haul stores from Downtown and Allapattah to Dadeland and the Doral area, and three U-Haul neighborhood dealers), plus two labor-only options
intro: This first Miami page covers truck-rental locations whose official Penske and U-Haul pages list a Miami address — six Penske desks (including two Home Depot stores in West Kendall and South Dade that are open until 7:30 PM every day), five company-run U-Haul stores that all publish Sunday hours, and three U-Haul neighborhood dealers. Two labor-only options are included for people who already have a truck or container: Bellhop, which lists a Ponce de Leon address, and College HUNKS, whose Miami labor page lists a Miami Gardens office. Budget, Enterprise Truck Rental, and most U-Haul dealers are not covered yet, and neither are Miami Beach, Hialeah, or Broward County. Several locations are in unincorporated Miami-Dade areas that use a Miami mailing address. We do not report live truck counts; one-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page itself mentions them.

listings.offersNotes: The official Miami page offers “Hourly moving help and labor”: “If you don’t need transportation but could use some moving help, Bellhop’s skilled Miami movers make quick work of loading, unloading, and/or rearranging.” The same page says Bellhop is a federally regulated property broker that connects customers with independent labor and/or transportation providers.
listings.visitNotes: Bellhop describes itself as a broker, so the crew may be a partner mover. Book online or by phone and confirm crew availability for your date.

listings.offersNotes: The official page says the Miami team offers “labor-only moving services by the hour,” including loading and unloading a moving truck, storage unit, or portable storage container. It says next-day or same-day service is possible in many cases.
